description: This file manages temporary file lifecycle including creation, activation, cleanup on exit or signal, renaming, and deletion. It maintains a linked list of temporary files, ensuring proper cleanup and permission handling. It also registers signal and exit handlers to prevent resource leaks and ensure cleanup.

classes.name: struct tempfile
classes.description: Represents a temporary file with fields for file descriptor, pointer, filename, owner PID, associated directory, and linked list linkage.

methods.name: int remove_template_directory(struct tempfile * tempfile,int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with a tempfile, considering if called from a signal handler.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles(int in_signal_handler)
methods.description: Iterates over the tempfile list, closing and unlinking active tempfiles owned by the current process.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_exit(void)
methods.description: Handler registered with atexit to clean up tempfiles on program exit.

methods.name: void remove_tempfiles_on_signal(int signo)
methods.description: Handler registered with signal chain to clean up tempfiles upon receiving a signal.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * new_tempfile(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new tempfile object.

methods.name: void activate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Adds the tempfile to the global list and sets its owner PID. Registers cleanup handlers on first use.

methods.name: void deactivate_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Removes the tempfile from the list, releases strings, and frees the memory.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * create_tempfile_mode(const char * path,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with specified mode and adds it to the list.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * register_tempfile(const char * path)
methods.description: Registers an existing path as a tempfile.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_sm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a filename based on a template and mode, in the current directory or default tmp.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_tsm(const char * filename_template,int suffixlen,int mode)
methods.description: Creates a tempfile with a filename based on a template and mode, in TMPDIR or /tmp.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * mks_tempfile_dt(const char * directory_template,const char * filename)
methods.description: Creates a directory-based tempfile from a directory template, creating a directory and then a file.

methods.name: struct:tempfile * xmks_tempfile_m(const char * filename_template,int mode)
methods.description: Wraps mks_tempfile_m, dies on failure.

methods.name: FILE * fdopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile,const char * mode)
methods.description: Opens a FILE* stream for the tempfile's file descriptor.

methods.name: const char * get_tempfile_path(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the filename of the tempfile.

methods.name: int get_tempfile_fd(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: FILE * get_tempfile_fp(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Returns the FILE* associated with the tempfile.

methods.name: int close_tempfile_gently(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor or FILE*, managing errors.

methods.name: int reopen_tempfile(struct tempfile * tempfile)
methods.description: Reopens the tempfile file descriptor after closing it.

methods.name: int rename_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p,const char * path)
methods.description: Renames a tempfile to a new location, closing and deactivating it.

methods.name: int delete_tempfile(struct tempfile ** tempfile_p)
methods.description: Deletes and deallocates the tempfile, closing, unlinking, and removing directory if any.

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_sm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_sm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/

ctags.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
ctags.pattern: /^struct tempfile *mks_tempfile_tsm(const char *filename_template, int suffixlen, int mode)$/
